name: Compute Shader Voxel Raycasting with Corner Ray Interpolation
definition: A compute shader-based ray tracing method that generates view rays for each framebuffer pixel by bilinearly interpolating four world-space corner rays of the camera's view frustum, then traces them through a 3D voxel/SVO texture to produce a color image.
summary: This method generates view rays by bilinearly interpolating four pre-computed corner vectors, avoiding per-pixel matrix multiplications to trace 3D voxel textures.
